issues.on_page: General and administrative: Sewer Fund 283,461, Arena Fund 134,109, Total 417,570
issues.issue: [fixed: utilities (Sewer 283,461 of 417,570)] Mixed line; the dominant part is the Sewer Fund (283,461 of 417,570), so under the dominant-category rule it should be utilities, not culture/recreation. The category seems to have been copied from FY2024, where the Arena part was the larger one (577,839 vs 259,512), but this year's page doesn't support it (2026-11-12 ruling). The extraction's own review note shows the Sewer amount is the larger one.

Equity line has no category. Ralston FY2024 has categories on its equity lines (e.g. Unrestricted). Same for equity[1] Unrestricted 2,292,617, equity[3] Restricted 1,856,748 and equity[4] Unrestricted 680,722.
The function is taken from the fund name (marked computed). The FY2022 ruling says to add a function only when one is printed; the Street Fund name is reasonable evidence, but it is an assumption.

issues.on_page: Cash and investments held with trustee 3,727,089
issues.issue: The page doesn't label it restricted. It fits 'cash and investments' (a line combining both) just as well. The category matches FY2024 and the restricted Community Development fund balance, so it is defensible.
